title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Autopay Mileage Credit
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — mileage credit for monthly payments made by autopay**

**Rule.** The autopay mileage credit is 1000 miles (the high autopay miles) when the number of the lease's monthly payments made through autopay ACH, less the number of payments on the lease that were returned, is at least 24 (the high autopay count); 500 miles (the low autopay miles) when that number is at least 12 (the low autopay count) but below 24; and nothing when it is below 12. The credited miles are added to the mileage allowance before the miles driven are compared with it.

**The count.** Monthly payments posted on the lease through the autopay ACH channel are counted; then every payment on the lease that was returned is subtracted, whichever channel it came through.

| Monthly payments by autopay ACH | Payments on the lease returned | Count | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 | 0 | 30 | 1000 miles |
| 25 | 1 | 24 | 1000 miles |
| 24 | 1 | 23 | 500 miles |
| 12 | 0 | 12 | 500 miles |
| 13 | 2 | 11 | nothing |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a lease paid 26 months by autopay ACH with one returned online payment counts 25 and takes 1000 miles; an allowance of 36000 miles is compared with the miles driven as 37000.
